Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Shorts
- T-shirts
- Long-sleeve shirts for sun protection
- Lightweight pants or jeans
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Pajamas

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Aloe vera gel
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Makeup and makeup remover

Accessories:
- Sunglasses
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag or tote
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (if applicable)

Electronics:
- Waterproof phone case
- Waterproof camera or GoPro
- Power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

Miscellaneous:
- Passport or ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Printed itinerary or reservations
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Waterproof dry bag for snacks or small items
- Books or e-reader
- Waterproof backpack or tote
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs for better sleep
